title: Exterior presheaf under open pullback
statement: For a scheme X, an O_X-module M, a natural number n and an open U, the presheaf pullback along U.ι of the sectionwise exterior-power presheaf is isomorphic to the sectionwise exterior-power presheaf of M.restrict U.ι.

proof.text: The old exteriorSheafPresheaf and the upstream PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower have definitionally identical section modules. For every inclusion their restriction maps agree by exteriorSheafRestriction_existsUnique and PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_ιMulti. Equality of the presheaf structures follows by function extensionality and proof irrelevance. Rewrite both presheaves using this equality, apply the upstream component-data theorem, and assemble its components using PresheafOfModules.isoMk.

proof_origin.note: Retirement adaptation: compare the two sectionwise exterior-power APIs by their common universal characterization; use the proved upstream component data. The original public signature is retained.
